title: Yesterday Was Supposed to Be About Lower Volatility
summary: Would you have signed up for a 1.8% two-day drop in the S&P 500 (SPX) as the election results came in? You might not have been happy about it, but given the magnitude of the political dislocation, I’m guessing that you would have been okay with that. As I type this around noon, that’s pretty much what we have. The difference is that we’re arriving at that point via a roller coaster ride rather than a modest, orderly selloff. Yesterday was “socially acceptable volatility” writ large. Today is just plain old volatility – quite a bit of it.
